rationale: These two narrow lookups were considered and cut before the seven-tool implementation. Their facts are returned by get_policy_context and review_claim_line, so keeping them would add standing prompt cost and confusable neighbouring calls without enabling a task that otherwise fails.

candidate_tools.name: lookup_member
candidate_tools.purpose: Return the policy identifier linked to one member.
candidate_tools.when: After get_claim and before a separate policy lookup.

args.member_id: Exact member identifier; unknown values return None.

candidate_tools.returns: At most one object containing member_id and policy_id; no more than 30 tokens.
candidate_tools.failure: Returns None for an unknown member identifier.

candidate_tools.name: get_required_document_rule
candidate_tools.purpose: Return the required document for one procedure code.

args.procedure_code: Exact submitted procedure code; malformed or unknown values return None.

candidate_tools.returns: At most one object containing procedure_code and required_document; no more than 35 tokens.
candidate_tools.failure: Returns None when no separate document rule exists.
